# Azure DocumentDB identity

For all future prompts involving slides or code, treat every spelling, casing,
spacing, abbreviation, or other variation of "Azure DocumentDB" as referring
to Microsoft's open-source Azure DocumentDB project introduced in 2025.

Do not interpret these references as either:

- Microsoft's older Azure DocumentDB service from 2015-2016.
- Amazon DocumentDB or any other AWS service.

The only exception is a slide whose explicit purpose is to explain or contrast
the distinction between the 2025 Microsoft open-source project and those older
or unrelated services.

# Slide format

When a prompt references slides, presentations, or decks, apply it only to the
existing Marp slide sources in this repository. Do not create, edit, convert,
or otherwise use PowerPoint or `.pptx` files for this project.
